title: El Hugeirat language - Wikipedia
text: El Hugeirat (also El Hagarat) is a moribund Hill Nubian language spoken in the northern Nuba Mountains of southern Sudan. It is spoken by approximately 50 people in a few families within the El Hugeirat hills, specifically in the villages of Sija, Bija, Shenishen, and Baboy.
